title: Replacing the GitHub runner: SportsGameOdds is not answering
body: SportsGameOdds failed 5 checks in a row (refused: Refused (HTTP 403): this key is not accepted (your plan does not include the usage prompt).) and the scans are not getting data from it. The engine restarted its connection and now ends this job after the scan it is on so a new runner (a new address) starts: 1 of 3. After 3 it will switch SportsGameOdds off and tell you.
